# Outfit variable font (vendored)

Copied unchanged from the npm package `@fontsource-variable/outfit@5.3.0`
(https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource-variable/outfit/-/outfit-5.3.0.tgz, sha512
`fPb5XnYK0k7SbR++HEmm4+ZqDszmLKQ+sPRUr8oQ/KNC0vy6r6hazJFe8iYozv4cqlHbvJ/JECkJWrfDodUMVQ==`).
Weight axis 100-900, latin and latin-ext subsets. The `@font-face` rules
and unicode ranges in `css/styles.css` follow the package's `wght.css`.

Font: Copyright 2021 The Outfit Project Authors
(https://github.com/Outfitio/Outfit-Fonts), SIL Open Font License 1.1,
see `OFL.txt`.
